# Six Themes of the 24 Steps

The 24 Steps are discrete and can be grouped into six themes. Each step should be done in numerical order with the understanding that in each step, you will learn things that will prompt you to revise the work you have done in earlier steps. These themes present a general outline of how the 24 Steps will help you create a sustainable, innovation-based business.
